notes:
SUMMARY:
- Multi-language enterprise search platform focused on cross-lingual retrieval + reranking for regulated customers across EU public sector and finance.
- Primary objective: one unified index + per-language reranker to hit high recall on queries in 18 languages (EN, FR, DE, ES, PT, NL, IT, PL, RU, AR, ZH, JA, KO, HI, BN, MI, AM, MY).

POC / TECH REQUIREMENTS:
- Index scale: starting POC ~250k docs, target production 1.5M-2M docs (mix of long-form PDFs, HTML, intranet content). Expect growth to 10M+ over 12–18 months.
- Storage/Vector store: experimenting with sharded index approach; need recommendations for shard sizing, quantization (4-bit/8-bit) impact on recall per language.
- Reranking: lightweight cross-encoder reranker to boost per-language precision; acceptable end-to-end latency budget for a typical query: 120–200ms (95th) for EN/FR/DE, 200–350ms for low-resource langs.
- Throughput: baseline 50 req/s during business hours; burst to 250 req/s for search-heavy workflows.
- Cost sensitivity: target avg cost/query <= $0.004 (vector + rerank combined) to meet commercial metrics. AE/finance will push for clear per-query cost model before committing.

SECURITY/COMPLIANCE:
- Must support SSO/SAML for internal teams, audit logging, encryption with customer-managed KMS.
- Data residency: legal requires FR in-country hosting for a subset of documents; also need EU-only control plane for certain customers.

QUOTES / CUSTOMER VOICE:
- CTO (S. Lefevre): "We can tolerate a little latency on less common languages but not when FR/DE regress. Per-language recall curves are our gating metric."
- Head of Search (R. Novak): "Show us single API for hosted + private with identical behavior; we don't want a second tooling path for EU-hosted material."

TECH ENG NOTES / OPEN QUESTIONS:
- Want Redwood Optimize suggestions: batching + caching profiles tailored by language distribution; model quantization tradeoffs.
- Need benchmark harness: per-language recall@10/precision@10 across 18 langs using customer seed queries (shared via Drive).
- POC to include: sample index (250k), embedding pipeline, distributed vector store, reranker integration, fallbacks to smaller models for cost control.
